title: How This Sign Shop Grew from $700K to $1.6M
description: An inspiring conversation about sustainable growth, building a meaningful sales strategy, and leading with purpose. Learn the one thing this shop did right to more than double their revenue.
keyTakeaways: Focus on one thing and do it exceptionally well
Build a sales strategy that aligns with your values
Lead with purpose to attract the right team and clients
Track metrics that matter, not vanity numbers
